# citeproc-js

Version: npm `citeproc@2.4.63` (processor 1.4.63), pinned in package-lock.json.
Copyright © 2009–2019 Frank Bennett. Original processor code is unchanged.

The upstream LICENSE offers CPAL 1.0 or AGPL 3.0-or-later. npm's package.json
uses the older label `CPAL-1.0 OR AGPL-1.0`; the actual license text is retained

is MIT. The complete CPAL text is included in CPAL-1.0.txt and publicly available
at `/licenses/citeproc-CPAL-1.0.txt`. The citation dialog displays the attribution.

Reproducible original source:
https://unpkg.com/citeproc@2.4.63/citeproc_commonjs.js
